trigger.interpretation: E125 measured vkUpdateDescriptorSetWithTemplate socket round trips as one of the two dominant per-frame RPC families.

implementation.selector: BVB_DESCRIPTOR_JOURNAL=strict|shared; strict is the default and invalid values fail before connecting
implementation.wire_payload: Each record contains the existing canonical pointer-free opcode-112 payload plus a fixed length/reserved header and zero alignment padding.
implementation.ordering: Every non-journal bridge exchange first drains pending updates, preserving host-call order relative to reset, destroy, submit, wait, and other RPC families.
implementation.service: The Bionic service takes one immutable private snapshot, validates the complete structural batch, then reconstructs and replays native descriptor updates in order.
implementation.failure: An uncertain or rejected flush permanently poisons the client connection; the journal is never retried against ambiguous native state.
implementation.strict_path: The original immediate opcode-112 RPC remains byte-for-byte available for A/B validation.

validation.next_wait_exchanges: one descriptor-journal flush followed by one device-wait-idle RPC

reuse: The required deja query returned no indexed implementation. E126 reuses E075/E075a's one-time sealed shared-memory setup, immutable service snapshot, monotonically sequenced replay, and permanent-poison failure discipline; E125's measured opcode-112 call/time distribution selects this gate.
next_gate: Deploy the exact E126 client/service with a final-process-only selector, repeat the complete benchmark and E117 profile, then address measured opcode-68 descriptor allocation traffic.
